Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor evidence required to complete PO (deadline 2026-09-01)

Ben —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. To get Novara set up in our ERP and push the initial PO through, our procurement team needs the following artifacts no later than 2026-09-01:  

- Signed DPA (or DocuSign routing link)
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (or a secure download link)
- Subprocessor roster with locations and purpose of processing
- Invoicing instructions and vendor code/PO acceptance details

Can you confirm whether Redwood can supply these items this week? Also please flag any data residency or subprocessor constraints we should be aware of for our legal intake.

Appreciate it — if you prefer a short call, we can do 30 minutes Monday.

—Clara Huang
Procurement Manager | Novara Systems
procurement@novara.io

Ben —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and links. A couple of clarifying items from our side before we move the PO:

If we can get those answers by Wednesday, we'll plan to route the PO and kick off e-signature.

Thanks —
Clara

Hi Clara —

Quick answers to the procurement items:  

- Vendor code: RWI-0291 (include this on the PO).
- Send PO to invoices@redwoodinference.com; we accept PDF POs or PO sent from your ERP as long as it contains the vendor code and billing address below.
- Billing address: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  400 Market St, Suite 150
  San Francisco, CA 94105
- Payment terms: Net 45 (unless otherwise negotiated on deal paperwork). Pre-approved exceptions require finance sign-off (cc Marissa).

On subprocessors / key material: Redwood does not share customer plaintext or key material with subprocessors. Subprocessors operate under contract with limited access (logs, telemetry, managed services); anything requiring key custody is kept in customer-managed KMS integrations or HSM for Private deployments. Clause 6.3 for audit rights is present in our DPA (see section 7 in the attached PDF). If Novara needs an addendum for explicit audit language, we can raise that with legal — please indicate exact wording required.

If this all looks good we can expect the PO and then route DPA via DocuSign for signature.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
